title: amerimnon lateriflorum
intro: Amerimnon lateriflorum, commonly known as the Mexican buckthorn or Mexican buckeye, is a flowering plant species native to Mexico and Central America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, colds, and sore throats due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Amerimnon lateriflorum include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
